steps.name: 세션 칩 - 편집기와 같은 문구·메뉴(웹 세션 시작)
steps.js: const c=document.querySelector("#sessChip"); const t=c.textContent; c.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const items=[...document.querySelectorAll(".menu button")].map(b=>b.textContent); const ok=/세션 연결 없음/.test(t) && t.includes("▾") && items.some(x=>x.includes("웹 세션 시작")); document.querySelectorAll(".menu").forEach(m=>m.remove()); return ok ? true : JSON.stringify({t,items});

steps.name: 웹 세션 시작 창 - 에이전트 확인·닫기(wsession.js)
steps.js: document.querySelector("#sessChip").click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); [...document.querySelectorAll(".menu button")].find(b=>b.textContent.includes("웹 세션 시작")).click(); for (let i=0;i<32 && !(document.querySelector("#sessDlg .box select, #sessDlg .box [data-sd=close]"));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); const d=document.querySelector("#sessDlg"); const shown=d.classList.contains("show"), txt=d.innerText; d.querySelector("[data-sd=close]").click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); return shown && /웹 세션 시작|확인 실패/.test(txt) && !d.classList.contains("show") ? true : JSON.stringify({shown, txt:txt.slice(0,200)});

steps.name: 요청 첨부 - 그림 붙여넣기 → 축소판
steps.js: const b=Uint8Array.from(atob("iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8DwHwAFBQIAX8jx0gAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="),c=>c.charCodeAt(0)); const f=new File([b],"image.png",{type:"image/png"}); const dt=new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(f); const ta=document.querySelector("#reqText"); ta.focus(); ta.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent("paste",{clipboardData:dt,bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); for (let i=0;i<32 && !(document.querySelector("#reqAtt .a img"));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); return !!document.querySelector("#reqAtt .a img") || document.querySelector("#reqAtt").innerHTML;

steps.name: 범위 요청 + 첨부 보내기
steps.js: const N=window.NexaSheet; N.S.sel={r1:0,c1:0,r2:1,c2:1}; document.querySelector("#reqWhole").checked=false; document.querySelector("#reqWhole").dispatchEvent(new Event("change")); document.querySelector("#reqText").value="첨부 그림처럼 바꿔 줘"; document.querySelector("#reqSend").click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const q=await (async()=>{ const l=await (await fetch("/api/requests/zsheetfill")).json(); return l[l.length-1]; })(); return q && q.range==="A1:B2" && q.status==="open" && (q.attachments||[]).length===1 && !document.querySelector("#reqAtt .a") ? true : JSON.stringify(q);

steps.name: 카드 축소판 → 라이트박스
steps.js: for (let i=0;i<32 && !(document.querySelector("#reqList .att.ro .a"));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); document.querySelector("#reqList .att.ro .a").click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const el=document.querySelector(".nx-lb"), lb=!!el && el.style.display!=="none"; if (el) el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"Escape",bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); return lb && el.style.display==="none" ? true : "lb=" + lb + " display=" + (el && el.style.display);

steps.name: 진행 동기화 - 밖에서 working → 처리 중 표시
steps.js: const q=await (async()=>{ const l=await (await fetch("/api/requests/zsheetfill")).json(); return l[l.length-1]; })(); await fetch("/api/requests/zsheetfill",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({action:"update",id:q.id,status:"working"})}); for (let i=0;i<32 && !(document.querySelector(`#reqList .req[data-rid="${q.id}"] .st.working .spin`));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); const c=document.querySelector(`#reqList .req[data-rid="${q.id}"]`); return c && c.querySelector(".st.working .spin") && document.querySelector("#marks .reqBox.working") ? true : (c ? c.outerHTML.slice(0,300) : "카드 없음");

steps.name: 처리 중엔 열 때 계산값 자동 저장을 미룬다
steps.js: const r=await fetch("/api/deck/zsheetfill"); const v=r.headers.get("X-Deck-Version"); const d=await r.json(); d.sheets[0].cells.Z1={f:"=1+1"}; const p=await fetch("/api/deck/zsheetfill?base="+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:"PUT",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(d)}); const v2=(await p.json()).version; for (let i=0;i<32 && !(window.NexaSheet.S.deck.sheets[0].cells.Z1 && window.NexaSheet.S.deck.sheets[0].cells.Z1.v===2);i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500)); const v3=(await fetch("/api/version/zsheetfill").then(x=>x.json())).deck; const c=window.NexaSheet.S.deck.sheets[0].cells.Z1; return p.ok && c && c.v===2 && v3===v2 && !window.NexaSheet.S.dirty ? true : JSON.stringify({ok:p.ok, c, v2, v3, dirty:window.NexaSheet.S.dirty});

steps.name: 진행 동기화 - done + reply → 카드가 남아 답 표시
steps.js: const q=await (async()=>{ const l=await (await fetch("/api/requests/zsheetfill")).json(); return l[l.length-1]; })(); await fetch("/api/requests/zsheetfill",{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify({action:"update",id:q.id,status:"done",reply:"바꿨습니다 - A1:B2"})}); for (let i=0;i<32 && !(document.querySelector(`#reqList .req.done[data-rid="${q.id}"] .reply`));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); const c=document.querySelector(`#reqList .req[data-rid="${q.id}"]`); return c && c.classList.contains("done") && c.querySelector(".reply").textContent.includes("바꿨습니다") && !document.querySelector("#marks .reqBox") ? true : (c ? c.outerHTML.slice(0,300) : "카드 없음(완료 요청이 사라짐)");

steps.name: Z1 지우기(다음 실행용)
steps.js: const r=await fetch("/api/deck/zsheetfill"); const v=r.headers.get("X-Deck-Version"); const d=await r.json(); delete d.sheets[0].cells.Z1; const p=await fetch("/api/deck/zsheetfill?base="+encodeURIComponent(v),{method:"PUT",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(d)}); return p.ok;

steps.name: 후속 요청 - 카드 안 입력칸(편집기와 같은 nexa-requests.js) · Enter 로 보내기
steps.js: const q=await (async()=>{ const l=await (await fetch("/api/requests/zsheetfill")).json(); return l[l.length-1]; })(); for (let i=0;i<32 && !(document.querySelector(`#reqList .req[data-rid="${q.id}"] [data-fu]`));i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250)); document.querySelector(`#reqList .req[data-rid="${q.id}"] [data-fu]`).click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const ta=document.querySelector("#fuText"); if(!ta) return "입력칸 없음"; ta.value="하나 더"; ta.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"Enter",bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const n=await (async()=>{ const l=await (await fetch("/api/requests/zsheetfill")).json(); return l[l.length-1]; })(); return n.parent===q.id && n.text==="하나 더" && !document.querySelector("#fuText") ? true : JSON.stringify(n);

steps.name: 요청 기록 창([더보기]) - 찾기·이 탭
steps.js: document.querySelector("#reqMore").click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); const h=document.querySelector("#reqHist"); if(!h) return "창 없음"; const inp=h.querySelector("input"); inp.value="하나 더"; inp.dispatchEvent(new Event("input")); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,300)); const n=h.querySelectorAll("#rhList .req").length; h.querySelector('#rhScope [data-v="here"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const scope=h.querySelector('#rhScope [data-v="here"]').textContent; h.querySelector("#rhClose").click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); return n>=1 && scope==="이 탭" && !document.querySelector("#reqHist") ? true : JSON.stringify({n,scope});

steps.name: 요청 칸 Enter = 보내기 · Shift+Enter = 줄바꿈 · 조합 중 Enter 는 안 보냄
steps.js: const ta=document.querySelector("#reqText"); const n0=(await (await fetch("/api/requests/zsheetfill")).json()).length; ta.value="줄"; const kd=(o)=>{ const e=new KeyboardEvent("keydown",{key:"Enter",bubbles:true,cancelable:true,...o}); ta.dispatchEvent(e); return e.defaultPrevented; }; const a=kd({shiftKey:true}), b=kd({isComposing:true}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const n1=(await (await fetch("/api/requests/zsheetfill")).json()).length; const c=kd({}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500)); const n2=(await (await fetch("/api/requests/zsheetfill")).json()).length; return !a && !b && n1===n0 && c && n2===n0+1 && ta.value==="" ? true : JSON.stringify({a,b,c,n0,n1,n2,v:ta.value});
